title: 10 第十章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

【张书迪】：？？？你说啥？

【张书迪】：不敢眨眼，希望是我的幻觉。

【霍飞冬】：那我的论文怎么办！！！

【张书迪】：呃，所以为啥突然要取消寒假工作，还有回学校干嘛，要带什么东西吗？

【荣文山】：啥情况，非要回学校的话，昨天聚餐时咋没通知？

【周西】：真是可怕的消息。我这边都快完工了，现在取消真的好吗？大家的学分怎么处理？

【赵大力】：……才刚放寒假就快完工了，你也很可怕好吗！@周西

一片吵吵嚷嚷中，班长路晨翼只回答了张书迪的那句“要带什么东西”。

【班长-路晨翼】：带上通讯器跟学生卡就好。

都竞华看着群里不断刷屏的消息，感觉自己再一次受到了命运的针对。

昨天刚遇见的超自然事件，都竞华本来是打算趁着假期先休整一些天。

路晨翼工作很认真，就算都竞华今天没有按时起床，估计很快也会接到班长的电话。

那么是否需要请假……

合适的请假理由没那么好找，尤其是自己刚参加了昨晚的聚餐，现在必定还在城区范围内。

没说得过去的借口，却又拒不露面，在一众同学间未免过于显眼了些。

都竞华自觉是个低调且从众的人，并不想引起不必要的关注。

从论坛上看，世界上的合法玩家数量并不少，以都竞华对联盟的了解，覆盖大部分区域的监控以及智能数据处理系统足以让有关部门的人及时了解到游戏的存在，并暗中做出干预。

在玩家数量尚少的情况下，联盟会将所有觉醒者当做需要警惕的危险分子，但在意识到觉醒的趋势无法遏制后，联盟大概率会站在数量更多的合法玩家那一边，尽早在游戏中为自己争取利益。

可惜都竞华的阵营在非正常力量中属于见不得光的那一部分。

都竞华有些庆幸现在住在赤河中路，距离学校不算近，多少争取了点时间。

——她还没毕业，之所以选择一个远离学校同时荒凉到缺乏适宜大学生的各种活动的区域暂住，是因为这里离都竞华的假期工作地点比较近。

都竞华的就读院校全名为联盟红浮市第一自由大学，专业挺冷门，叫做古代遗迹学。

当初因为古代遗迹学实在难招人，分数线自然不高，专业中的大多数学生都跟都竞华一样，最初是被校方免学费且包就业的口号给骗进来的。

别的还凑合，包就业确确实实让都竞华十分满意。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

[Zhang Shudi]:???What did you say?

[Zhang Shudi]: I don’t dare to blink, I hope it’s my imagination.

[Huo Feidong]: What about my thesis!!!

[Zhang Shudi]: Well, why did you suddenly cancel your winter vacation work? Why go back to school? Do you need to bring anything?

[Rong Wenshan]: What's going on? If you have to go back to school, why didn't you notify me at the dinner party yesterday?

[Zhou west]: What terrible news.I'm almost done here, is it really okay to cancel now?How to deal with everyone’s credits?

[Zhao Dali]: ...It’s just winter vacation and it’s almost finished. You’re scary too, okay!@zhou西

In the midst of the commotion, squad leader Lu Chenyi only answered Zhang Shudi's question, "What should I bring?"

[Monitor-Lu Chenyi]: Just bring your communicator and student card.

Du Jinghua looked at the messages in the group that kept flooding the screen, feeling that he was once again being targeted by fate.

Du Jinghua originally planned to take advantage of the holiday to rest for a few days after encountering the supernatural incident he just encountered yesterday.

Lu Chenyi was very serious about his work. Even if Du Jinghua didn't get up on time today, he would probably receive a call from the monitor soon.

So do you need to take leave...

It's not that easy to find a suitable reason for asking for leave, especially since I just attended last night's dinner party and must still be within the city limits.

He had no excuse, but he refused to show up, which made him too conspicuous among his classmates.

Du Jinghua feels that he is a low-key and conformist person, and does not want to attract unnecessary attention.

Judging from the forum, there are not many legal players in the world. Du Jinghua's understanding of the alliance, monitoring and intelligent data processing systems covering most areas are enough for people from relevant departments to learn about the existence of the game in a timely manner and secretly intervene.

When the number of players is still small, the Alliance will treat all awakened ones as dangerous elements that need to be vigilant. However, after realizing that the trend of awakening cannot be curbed, the Alliance will most likely side with the larger number of legal players and strive for their own interests in the game as soon as possible.

It's a pity that Du Jinghua's camp is a shady part among the abnormal forces.

Du Jinghua is somewhat fortunate that he now lives on Chihe Middle Road, which is not too close to the school and has bought him some time.

——She has not graduated yet. The reason why she chose an area far away from school and so desolate that it lacks various activities suitable for college students to live temporarily is because it is relatively close to Du Jinghua’s holiday workplace.

The full name of the school Du Jinghua attended was the First Free University of Alliance Hongfu City, and its major was a rather unpopular one, called Ancient Relics.

At first, it was difficult to recruit people for the ancient ruins major, so the score line was naturally not high. Like Du Jinghua, most students in the major were initially tricked into joining the school by the school's slogan of free tuition and guaranteed employment.

Everything else was okay, and Du Jinghua was really satisfied with the employment package.
